dialogue.patient: I vomited blood, doctor — bright red. And I've been passing black stools like tar.
The blood was about two hours ago. The black stool was once, this morning.
I go grey when I stand up. The room tipped over on me this morning.
There's a gnawing pain at the pit of my stomach. It's been there a while now.
I'm on aspirin and clopidogrel — for my heart. And blood pressure tablets.
No, I don't take any other painkillers.
My weight's the same as always.
My belly isn't swollen. My eyes aren't yellow.
